segments.name: Marketing services
segments.description: Provides advertisers, agencies, publishers and broadcasters an end-to-end advertising technology platform to plan, buy, sell and measure advertising across formats and devices.
segments.evidence: The Group has a single reportable segment as a provider of marketing services.

revenueModel.text: Advertisers, agencies and digital publishers pay platform fees based on a percentage of spend, flat fees or fixed CPMs.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate revenue through platform fees based on either (i) a percentage of spend, (ii) flat fees or (iii) fixed CPMs ("cost per mille") that are tailored to fit our customers' specific utilization of our solutions.

changes.text: The company changed its name to Nexxen International Ltd. in January 2024.
changes.evidence: We changed our name to Taptica International Ltd. in September 2015, then to Tremor International Ltd. in June 2019, and to Nexxen International Ltd., in January 2024.
